title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Mirror-gaps sequence re-scoped. P0 at 7d5d890, P1 at 7b8acd2 with receipts proven by execution, P2 at 9e36674 (4 commits stacked on P1) green at 1818/0 but BLOCKED on five anchored defects (0166). CHANGE 1's monotone premise is REFUTED (0164), so P2 ships two changes not three. P3-P5 collapsed under the conditionality gate (0162); only A7 survives. NOTHING pushed, no PR open, main still 1bb149d, and no coverage entry exists on any of the three branches.
spine.next_step: START HERE. (1) FIX P2 per 0166 - five defects, anchors at 9e36674; every twin edit lands in BOTH copies in one commit. (2) AUTHOR three coverage entries (P1, P0, P2), 12 ids each, orchestrator-authored per 0143, in each PR's own diff. (3) Unset the upstream on docs/track-m2-mirror-gaps-plan before pushing. (4) Push ONCE per branch, then PRs via mitosis-git.mjs pr-create - NEVER gh pr create - order P1, P0, P2; retitle P2 off any monotone claim (0164). (5) THEN A7 only (0162).
open_risks: P2 is GREEN at 1818/0 WITH all five defects of 0166 present. The suite is not the gate for any of them. Do not let a green run substitute for the fix list.

D3 matters most (0166): parking.mjs:114 coerces a missing builtUnits to an EMPTY Set, :120 gates on it, and mitosis.js:3766 tells the agent to return checkpointRefPages=[] when there is no remote. An expected return parks EVERY built unit. The new parking test blesses it - rewrite it.

P2 is STACKED on P1: 5 commits ahead of origin/main, one of them P1's 7b8acd2. Its PR base is test/mirror-census-closure, not main. If P1 merges first, P2 needs a rebase, and P1's coverage commit is not in P2's history.

docs/track-m2-mirror-gaps-plan is the ONLY branch with upstream tracking, pointing at refs/heads/main. push.default=simple blocks a bare push today, so it is latent not live - unset it before pushing anything.

P2's increment is 484 changed lines against a 200-400 budget, 713 cumulative. Production is 141, of which 38 are the mandated inline twin - about 70 lines of new logic. The overrun is all test mass. Any split must keep each twin edit atomic.

Found, NOT fixed: relaunchStateFor seeds 'awaiting' for any id in runOpenPRs.accepted, and classifyRunOpenPRs accepts a PR whose unit is built OR parked - so a parked unit with an open PR is seeded awaiting, consulting only the condemned veto. Pre-existing. Needs its own record.

0164's refutation is a TRACED path, not an executed reproduction, and swept only foldObservedStatus and the planReconcile condemned reset - Waves, Integrate and Ship were never swept for status assignments. Demand the reproduction before reopening CHANGE 1.

NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL agents. mitosis.js is read as TEXT only - held by every subagent across both workflows this session.
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval. Batch edits per file; no unattended fan-out.

The pre-commit hook runs the FULL suite inline (1818 on P2, 1788 on P1, 1766 on P0 - the spread tracks which commits each branch carries). ALWAYS redirect and read only the info-prefixed tail. --no-verify only for a deliberately-red receipt commit.
A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied. Later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Push once BEFORE opening the PR (0141). Titles cap at 72 chars. Merge stays human-gated.

Landing stays SERIAL. P1, P0 and P2 all touch mitosis.js or mirror-guard.test.mjs neighbourhoods, and a policed-twin edit must land in both copies in one commit. Parallelize investigation, never landing.

ORCHESTRATION: never put an agent that switches branches in the same workflow phase as one reading the working tree. It happened this session (auditor vs reviewer); only careful snapshot fallback saved it.

Agent findings have inverted on verification four times (0159, 0163, 0164, and D3's understatement in 0166). Verify load-bearing claims against the mechanism - the correction cuts both ways, sometimes harsher than reported.
17 worktree entries remain live, unchanged this session; the reaper verb does not exist. The tree carries five pre-existing dirty paths - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
The 12 leaked worktrees, the Step 0 reaper, and the two parked stashes.
